senses.gloss: m. (גּוּר I; v. מְגוּרָה II) fellow-inhabitant, neighbor.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 2:20">Koh. R. to II, 20</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 25">Lev. R. s. 25</cite> <he>אנתתיה דמ׳</he> the wife of a neighbor (of the old man).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 8:5:8">Y. Yoma VIII, 45ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 4:9:2">Y. Ned. IV, end, 38ᵈ</cite> <he>הוה מָגִירֵיה וכ׳</he> was a neighbor of (living in the same court with) R. J.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 16:7:2">Y. Sabb. XVI, end, 15ᵈ</cite> <he>במגורה</he> (corr. acc.). Y. B. Bath. II, end, 13ᶜ <he>הוה מגיריה וכ׳</he> was his neighbor in the field and in the house (living in the same court).
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:26:1">Koh. R. to VII, 26</cite> <he>מ׳ ליסטיס</he> (not <cite ref="M00151"><he>מגיד</he></cite>) a neighbor who was a robber.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:19:1">Ib. X, 19</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מָגִירִין</he>, <he>מָגִירַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="M00171"><he>מָגוֹ׳</he></cite>. Y. Peah III, 17ᵈ top <he>מגו׳ נוכראין</he> gentile neighbors.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:31">Lam. R. to I, 5</cite> <he>כל מ׳ … למְגִירֵיהוֹן עבדין</he> do all neighbors, bent on doing evil, do it to their neighbors?—
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 48:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. XLVIII</cite> (prov.) <he>לא כמה דאמרת … דאמרין מָגוֹרַיָּה</he> (ed. Bub.) go not by what thy mother says (of thee), but what the neighbors say.
Cant. R. to VII, 2; a. fr.—[Lam. R. to II, 22 מגו ביתאי ed. (Ar. מגרוסי) read: מְגוֹרֵי ביתאי inmates of my house, v. קוסיטרפיזין.]—Fem. מְגִירְתָּא, מְגוּ׳.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Exodus 3:22">Targ. Y. II, Ex. III, 22</cite> <he>ממְגוּרְתָּהּ</he> (not … <he>רָתָהּ</he>).—

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5:8">Lev. R. s. 5</cite>, end <he>אתית לגבי מ׳ … שלמא עליך מְגִרְתִּי</he> she comes to a neighbor …, peace with thee, my neighbor! <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 6:3">Lev. R. s. 6</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="M00178"><he>מְגִירָתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 9:9">Ib. s. 9</cite> <he>אמרין לה מְגִירָתָהּ</he> (some ed. … <he>תא</he>) said her neighbors to her.
<cite ref="Nedarim 21b:9">Ned. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>דאמרין מְגִירָתָךְ עלה דברתך וכ׳</he> that thy neighbors will say of thy daughter &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:3:3">Y. Sabb. III, 5ᵈ</cite> bot. [read:] <he>ובלחוד דלא ידעין מ׳</he> (not <cite ref="M00176"><he>מגיריית</he></cite>) provided the neighbors do not know it.
